name: Particles
description: A canvas of small dots that drift and lean toward the pointer, for a background. They pause when off-screen and stop for reduced motion, leaving a still scatter.

color.description: Colour of the dots, any CSS colour. Defaults to the muted text colour.

isPaused.description: Stops the effect and shows it still.

requirements: Decoration only: the effect is aria-hidden, never takes focus and never blocks the pointer
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion) and inside an rdm-still container, and isPaused stops it too
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Paused while off-screen, and its animation frame is cancelled when it unmounts
A still scatter is drawn for reduced motion, inside rdm-still and with isPaused
Follows the pointer through the container, so it never needs pointer events of its own
screenReader: Not announced: the canvas is hidden from assistive technology

use_when: Giving a quiet section some depth
avoid_when: Behind small text or dense forms
Low-power or small screens with very high counts
anti_patterns: Dots in strong colours that fight with the text
